children: A powerful magnitude 7.6 earthquake struck off Panama on Friday, prompting the US Tsunami Warning System to warn that hazardous tsunami waves were possible along parts of the coasts of Panama, Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Peru, Nicaragua, Guatemala, El Salvador, and Mexico within the next three hours.
The system also said there was a tsunami threat to Hawaii.
